sentences.text:
Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.1437 Of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C."), seeking quash of the F.I.R. in Crime No.55 of 2019 of Peddapappur Police Station,
Anantapur District.
2.
Heard learned counsel for petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3. The petitioners are A-1 and A-2 in Crime No.55 of 2019 of Peddapappur Police Station, Anantapur District.

4. A case under Sections 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 57(1), 58 r/w 26(1), 30(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, was registered against them.
5.

Both the learned counsel for petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that this case is squarely covered by the earlier orders of this Court, whereby the prosecution initiated against various persons for the similar offences, was quashed by this Court.
6. Therefore, in the said facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioners herein, who are also similarly placed, are entitled to the similar relief.
7. In the result, this petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.55 of 2019 of Peddapappur Police Station, Anantapur District, are hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.

____________________________________________ JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY Date : 16-03-2020 AKN/ARR THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE CHEEKATI MANAVENDRANATH ROY CRIMINAL PETITION No.1437 OF 2020 Date :
